info.title: API.SH: GrabFood
info.description: The GrabFood API from API.SH: public GrabFood data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The food categories and collections GrabFood shows at a delivery point (e.g. For Sharing, deals, local favourites): id, name, description, image and `raw`. Pass an id to `/grabfood/v1/category`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grabfood-categories

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Delivery country (Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam or Cambodia; default SG).

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Delivery point latitude inside that country (default the main city centre; give both latitude and longitude).

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Delivery point longitude inside that country.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

categories.name: Unlimited Savings
categories.description: Free Delivery & Up to 30% off menu

get.description:
The restaurants in one GrabFood category or collection at a delivery point, with the category name, description and image. A tile that only opens a page of the Grab app (no restaurant list on the web) answers 404. Each restaurant: id, name, chain and branch name, cuisines, rating and rating count, distance (km), delivery time (minutes and text), delivery fee and discounted fee, currency, price level, halal flag, open flag and opening hours per weekday, promo flag and promo labels, labels (e.g. Only on Grab), deliverer, order options (delivery, takeaway, dine-in), business type, photo, logo, link, and `raw`. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grabfood-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Category id from `/grabfood/v1/categories` (same country).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Delivery country (Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam or Cambodia; default SG).

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Delivery point latitude inside that country (default the main city centre; give both latitude and longitude).

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Delivery point longitude inside that country.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pass `next_offset` from the previous response (steps of 32).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One GrabFood restaurant by id or link, with its full menu as delivered to a point: name, chain and branch, cuisines, rating and rating count, currency, address (unit, street, area, postcode, city, country), open flag and opening hours, labels, attributes (e.g. Halal), announcements, order limit, photo, link, and every menu section with its items (id, name, description, price, discounted price, discount, availability, images) and each item's option groups (min and max choices, options with their extra price). The country follows the restaurant id; `raw` holds the rest of the record.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grabfood-restaurant

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Restaurant id (the last part of its food.grab.com link), e.g. `4-C64ECF6XTE4HL2`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Or the restaurant link, e.g. `https://food.grab.com/sg/en/restaurant/us-pizza-funan-delivery/4-C64ECF6XTE4HL2`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Delivery country (by default the country of the restaurant).

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Delivery point latitude inside that country (default the main city centre; give both latitude and longitude).

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Delivery point longitude inside that country.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Restaurants that deliver to a point in Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam or Cambodia, as GrabFood lists them, optionally for keywords (a dish, cuisine or restaurant name; without `q` every restaurant nearby). Each restaurant: id, name, chain and branch name, cuisines, rating and rating count, distance (km), delivery time (minutes and text), delivery fee and discounted fee, currency, price level, halal flag, open flag and opening hours per weekday, promo flag and promo labels, labels (e.g. Only on Grab), deliverer, order options (delivery, takeaway, dine-in), business type, photo, logo, link, the dishes that match the keywords (name, description, price, discounted price, discount, image), its other branches and `raw`. `total` is the number of matches. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grabfood-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (dish, cuisine or restaurant), e.g. `pizza`. Empty lists every restaurant that delivers to the point.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Delivery country (Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam or Cambodia; default SG).

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Delivery point latitude inside that country (default the main city centre; give both latitude and longitude).

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Delivery point longitude inside that country.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pass `next_offset` from the previous response (steps of 32).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
